programs.title: AI-Powered Productivity Transformation & Strategic Leadership Training
programs.venue: Daffodil International University · Dr. Aminul Islam Seminar Hall & Erasmus Lab
programs.description:
A three-day training program for employees of Titas Gas PLC, organized by the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Daffodil International University in collaboration with the Human Resource Development Institute (HRDI).

The program brought together AI tools for everyday work, research and content creation, leadership building, ethical AI use, and the design of internal digital tools. The schedule combined instructor-led sessions and practical lab work, alongside campus activities and a closing ceremony.
topics: AI tools for workplace productivity: ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot
Research and knowledge workflows with NotebookLM and Perplexity AI
AI posters and videos with Gemini, Google Veo and CapCut
Internal tool design and deployment with Google Stitch and Bubble
programs.organizer: Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Daffodil International University

programs.title: AI-Powered Workplace Productivity & Smart Office Practices
programs.venue: Knowledge Tower, Daffodil International University · Room 201 KT (ceremonies) & Room 503 KT (training)
programs.description:
A one-day training program for employees of COATS Bangladesh, organized by the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Daffodil International University in collaboration with SkillJobs.

The program focused on practical AI skills for everyday office work: responsible use, prompt engineering, communication and documentation, analysis, planning, and presentations. Four training sessions incorporated assessment periods and an integrated hands-on workplace challenge.
topics: AI fundamentals, responsible use and workplace applications
Analysis and planning for office productivity
Integrated hands-on workplace challenge and assessment
